main.description: Get a specific tip sent by the authenticated user. Looks up by tip record uri, subject (recipient) DID, or record uri. These are mutually exclusive and resolved in that order.

uri.description: AT-URI of the tip record. Takes precedence over subject and recordUri.

subject.description: DID of the tip recipient. Takes precedence over recordUri.

recordUri.description: AT-URI of the record being tipped. Ignored if uri or subject is provided.
